separation_ru: DPO row/schema existence proves only contract availability; actual DPO quality requires concrete accepted rows with provenance, source/license, positive examples, near-miss negatives, leakage checks, and train/eval split.
DPO quality is not a training run; a training run needs run id, corpus refs/hashes, before/after metrics, held-out evaluation, ablation, checkpoint/manifest refs, and non-regression evidence.
A training run is not fresh-load or continue-training improvement; those require reloading a saved checkpoint into a fresh machine and continuing from an existing checkpoint with metric continuity.
The user local model lifecycle has common/global and user/adaptive personal legs; private data stays adaptive unless consent/license gates allow common training.
